About Letshelp

Who We Are

Letshelp is a humanitarian foundation helping poor, vulnerable and disadvantaged people through donations, relief and community development.

Our Vision

A world where everyone has an opportunity to live with dignity.

Our Values

Humanity · Transparency · Accountability · Compassion · Equality · Integrity · Responsibility

Leadership & Structure

Leadership profiles and the organizational structure will be published here once supplied by the foundation.

Our Mission

“Letshelp exists to provide meaningful assistance to people facing poverty, hardship and inequality. Through responsible donations, humanitarian programs and community partnerships, we work to create lasting positive change.”

Every contribution matters. Every act of kindness creates hope.
